milestones.title: Repository and CI foundation
milestones.goal: Make a clean checkout build and diagnose itself on Windows x64; establish portable core builds and honest completion evidence.

commits.subject: build(m00): establish pinned C++20 and dependency manifests
commits.outcome: Add MSVC x64 build, portable C++ core target, explicit feature options, dependency revisions and SPDX inventory; no floating dependencies or global -march=native.

commits.subject: feat(m00): add diagnostic CLI and portable test entry points
commits.outcome: Implement --version and --diagnose --json --no-gpu using actual build/platform data; establish CTest with a meaningful CLI/schema smoke contract and nonzero failure exits.

commits.subject: ci(m00): gate Windows builds and portable core checks
commits.outcome: Activate adapted CI templates; Debug/Release Windows build and CTest, Linux/macOS portable core smoke, plan validation, artifact logs and one stable quality-gate.

commits.subject: docs(m00): record reproducible bootstrap and milestone evidence
commits.outcome: Verify commands from a fresh checkout, record runner/toolchain versions and real CI URLs, create progress evidence and completion checkpoint after all required checks pass.

milestones.title: Graphics and sharing feasibility gate
milestones.goal: Prove the graphics abstraction, native frame sharing, presentation, and resource ownership before product architecture depends on them.

commits.subject: feat(m01): render native D3D11 textures through the candidate backend
commits.outcome: Exercise bgfx D3D11 with a minimal internal render interface; verify owned and imported textures, formats, fences and resource lifetime without UI dependencies.

commits.subject: feat(m01): prove Spout receive and send interoperability
commits.outcome: Use real external sender/receiver processes, repeated resolution changes, producer restarts and stalled frames; count CPU readbacks and GPU copies separately.

commits.subject: test(m01): characterize multi-output and decoder texture paths
commits.outcome: Run physical two-output tests plus D3D11 hardware decode/import spike, paired-output synchronization and failure injection; produce machine-readable frame and memory metrics.

commits.subject: docs(m01): select the rendering backend from measured evidence
commits.outcome: Accept bgfx only if all critical interop/recovery gates pass without a private long-lived fork; otherwise record a bounded native-D3D11 implementation behind the same interface. Fix reference machines and initial performance thresholds.

milestones.title: Domain model and parameter registry
milestones.goal: Define assets, instances, layers, compositions, cues, arbitrary surfaces and routing without GPU or UI object ownership.

commits.subject: feat(m02): model stable assets instances and multi-output compositions
commits.outcome: Use stable IDs and typed ports; independent placements get independent transports by default; explicit sharing reuses one live instance; reject dependency cycles.

commits.subject: feat(m02): model surface groups layouts and projection patches
commits.outcome: Support arbitrary surface counts, optional adjacency/seams, independent or continuous content layout and many-to-many surface/projector patches; no hard-coded wall/floor concepts.

commits.subject: feat(m02): add typed parameter registry and command transactions
commits.outcome: One registration path supplies validation, access modes, units, ranges, persistence metadata and API descriptors; commands cover structural edits and parameter changes with undo/redo.

commits.subject: test(m02): prove model invariants and capability-preserving round trips
commits.outcome: Verify stable addressing across rename/reorder, reference scope, source instance independence, transactional rollback, unsupported-adapter placeholders and cyclic-graph rejection.

milestones.title: Control service and remote contract
milestones.goal: Make the engine controllable and inspectable before building the full editor, including reliable structural commands and OSCQuery.

commits.subject: feat(m03): expose versioned commands snapshots and subscriptions
commits.outcome: Implement authoritative control state, command IDs, revisions, accepted/applied/error responses, structural transactions and resumable full-snapshot recovery; use local named-pipe IPC plus documented messages.

commits.subject: feat(m03): expose complete OSC and OSCQuery trees
commits.outcome: Adapt libossia or a justified replacement; serve HOST_INFO and advertised extensions, exact-path LISTEN and structure updates; normalize network writes through the command validator.

commits.subject: feat(m03): add local web server and Svelte editor shell
commits.outcome: Serve packaged static UI, run Vite separately in development, generate TypeScript contract types, show real engine state and reconnect diagnostics; add a minimal encoded preview endpoint.

commits.subject: test(m03): verify control parity reconnection and bounded traffic
commits.outcome: Exercise create/edit/delete/save commands through remote APIs and OSC methods, duplicate command deduplication, conflicting revisions, subscriptions after reconnect, slow-client backpressure and malformed messages.

milestones.title: Compositing and first projector output
milestones.goal: Deliver the first useful mapping path: a default composition, layers, one or several named outputs, simple surfaces and real output windows.

commits.subject: feat(m04): compile composition graphs into immutable render snapshots
commits.outcome: Render images/test patterns and nested compositions; cache reusable work, cull inactive branches and allocate transient textures from bounded pools.

commits.subject: feat(m04): present named outputs on persistent logical targets
commits.outcome: Separate desired output identity/configuration from detected monitors; create independent swapchains, output enable/blackout/freeze controls and a native output path independent of the browser.

commits.subject: feat(m04): map surfaces with quad patches masks and color rules
commits.outcome: Implement four-corner homography, crop/fit/fill, simple masks, compositing blend modes, consistent premultiplied alpha and defined input/output transfer functions.

commits.subject: test(m04): verify default mapping multi-output composition and UI loss
commits.outcome: Run one-surface golden path, one composition over three surface regions, one surface across two projector patches and several surfaces on one projector; kill/reload UI and compare outputs within defined color tolerances.

milestones.title: Media library and baseline playback
milestones.goal: Import and organize real content while keeping decoding and filesystem work off deadline-sensitive threads.

commits.subject: feat(m05): import organized assets with background probing
commits.outcome: Add folders/tags/search, drag import, thumbnails, metadata, relative paths, incremental hashes, offline placeholders, usage inspection and cancellable background jobs.

commits.subject: feat(m05): decode baseline video on the shared show clock
commits.outcome: Integrate pinned FFmpeg libraries, rational timestamps, video/audio synchronization, bounded decoded-frame queues, loops, play/pause/stop and explicit late-frame policies.

commits.subject: feat(m05): separate source definitions from playback instances
commits.outcome: Create independent clip transports from a shared asset, implement explicit shared instances, manage source/preload reference counts and expose real readiness/capacity state.

commits.subject: test(m05): verify playback timing import cancellation and relinking
commits.outcome: Use generated and legally redistributable CFR/VFR/audio/alpha/missing/corrupt fixtures, loop boundaries, independent playheads, shared-instance semantics and large-file paths.

milestones.title: Composition editor and remote workflow
milestones.goal: Make common editing actions fast, discoverable and consistent across the local and remote browser.

commits.subject: feat(m06): implement composition canvas and natural transform tools
commits.outcome: Add accurate selection, multiselect, gizmos, pivot/scale/rotate, snapping, alignment, keyboard nudging, zoom/pan and contextual inspectors with consistent undo.

commits.subject: feat(m06): make nested ownership and asset reuse visible
commits.outcome: Add hierarchy/breadcrumbs, reveal-in-library, find-usages, make-independent and promote-to-reusable actions; inline instances remain reachable from the hierarchy.

commits.subject: feat(m06): complete remote preview and media import workflow
commits.outcome: Use engine-authoritative previews with timestamps/revisions and client-rendered overlays; support resumable uploads, engine-side file browsing, large imports and single-writer edit ownership.

commits.subject: test(m06): qualify editing interactions and live development updates
commits.outcome: Playwright covers drag/drop, handles, shortcuts, focus/text-input rules, undo, reconnect and upload interruption; record a short interaction review on the real composition canvas and verify Vite reload does not stop output.

milestones.title: Cues routing and transition bank
milestones.goal: Make launching simple or multi-output content one operation, with predictable preparation, timing and transitions.

commits.subject: feat(m07): add cue assignments and reusable routing presets
commits.outcome: Support Replace/Keep/Clear per destination, drag-to-create cues, semantic port matching with persisted overrides, independent surface actions and arbitrary groups.

commits.subject: feat(m07): stage prepare and atomically apply ready cues
commits.outcome: Prepare all required resources before GO, schedule one show-clock boundary, report accepted versus applied frame, enforce timeout/fallback policy and define re-trigger/interruption behavior.

commits.subject: feat(m07): add a curated editable shader transition bank
commits.outcome: Start with cut, dissolve, dip, wipe, luma and selected adapted shaders; version manifests, defaults, color/alpha behavior, license/attribution and deterministic seeds; compile off the render thread.

commits.subject: test(m07): verify grouped transitions partial changes and instance conflicts
commits.outcome: Validate one/three/curved surface sets, untouched destinations, synchronized clips, transition peak memory, parameter-state crossfades requiring duplicate app instances or frozen outgoing frames, and repeated GO deduplication.

milestones.title: Managed apps and coherent multi-texture frames
milestones.goal: Deliver an explicit client protocol for discovery, process ownership, parameter control and named frame sets.

commits.subject: feat(m08): publish versioned app and output manifests
commits.outcome: Define app/package/instance/generation IDs, semantic output roles, dimensions, color/alpha, transport endpoints and supported lifecycle/control capabilities; ship a small reference client.

commits.subject: feat(m08): supervise launched and attached application instances
commits.outcome: Track real process handles, working directory and controlled environment, readiness beyond OSC connection, ownership, reference counts, graceful shutdown, crash-loop limits and restart generations.

commits.subject: feat(m08): publish and consume synchronized named frame sets
commits.outcome: Specify resource lifetime, publication order/fences, common frame identity and generation changes; support complete-set hold versus latest-per-port modes without claiming atomic capture from unrelated legacy senders.

commits.subject: test(m08): exercise discovery readiness source failure and routing
commits.outcome: Use one-output and three-output reference apps, missing/stalled ports, resolution changes, multiple app instances, old/new generation races, parameter mirroring without echo loops and reconnect after process death.

milestones.title: Optimized codecs and accurate scrubbing
milestones.goal: Meet the defined playback/scrubbing profiles and report the real decode path for every source.

commits.subject: perf(m09): implement hardware decode and HAP texture paths
commits.outcome: Add D3D11 hardware decode with supported format/profile queries, GPU color conversion and explicit fallback; use HAP reference decoding into compressed GPU textures with correct Q/alpha variants.

commits.subject: feat(m09): qualify ProRes DXV and professional format compatibility
commits.outcome: Exercise ProRes 422/4444, DXV variants, DNxHD/HR, CineForm, MJPEG, AV1 and common still/sequence formats; record import/playback/alpha/bit-depth/accelerated/scrub distinctions per fixture.

commits.subject: perf(m09): add indexed cancellable scrubbing and show proxies
commits.outcome: Use keyframe/PTS indices, generation-tagged requests, nearby/reverse caches and proxy-to-original mapping; settle accurately after dragging without stale seeks replacing newer frames.

commits.subject: test(m09): qualify codec workloads and disclose unsupported variants
commits.outcome: Run complete media corpus, exact settled-frame tests, rapid seek/reverse/loop cases and warm/cold throughput; optimize or document a bounded transcode path for DXV performance gaps, with unmet requirements still open.

milestones.title: Network input and output integrations
milestones.goal: Complete Spout, OMT and NDI send/receive paths with isolated queues, measured latency and explicit licensing decisions.

commits.subject: feat(m10): harden bidirectional Spout as a production adapter
commits.outcome: Finish sender/receiver selection, duplicate names, sender loss/reappearance, resolution/format changes, per-GPU affinity and persistent logical endpoint identity.

commits.subject: feat(m10): integrate OMT discovery receiving and output
commits.outcome: Build pinned official dependencies, negotiate frame/audio/color formats and timestamps, measure encode/decode cost and provide bounded queue/drop/recovery policies.

commits.subject: feat(m10): add the approved NDI integration and distribution path
commits.outcome: Resolve current SDK terms and application exception/vendor-permission requirements before distributing combined binaries; implement supported receive/send modes and package only the approved configuration. Keep this commit blocked if licensing is unresolved.

commits.subject: test(m10): qualify transport round trips and slow consumers
commits.outcome: Test each direction using independent peers, absent runtimes, bandwidth pressure, stalled receivers, rediscovery and alpha/color correctness; publish a tested capability matrix and dependency notices.

milestones.title: Curved surfaces and advanced manual mapping
milestones.goal: Extend simple quad mapping to arbitrary connected geometry while keeping content layout separate from projector calibration.

commits.subject: feat(m11): add mesh and Bezier surface editing
commits.outcome: Implement versioned tessellated geometry and UV charts with deterministic triangulation, selectable control points, constraints, numeric editing and reversibly refined detail.

commits.subject: feat(m11): add surface adjacency seams and continuous layouts
commits.outcome: Represent shared-edge correspondence and optional canvas continuity; allow local content to coexist with spanning content and reject invalid geometry with actionable diagnostics.

commits.subject: feat(m11): add projector blend masks and color correction
commits.outcome: Introduce overlap masks, blend/gamma profiles, per-projector color/LUT controls, test patterns and non-destructive calibration profiles independent of cues.

commits.subject: test(m11): verify curved multi-projector mapping and seam behavior
commits.outcome: Compare reference patterns on a curved mesh, three connected walls, a UV seam and overlapping projector patches; verify save/reopen and content replacement retain calibration exactly.

milestones.title: Recovery persistence and long-run stability
milestones.goal: Qualify failure behavior already introduced in earlier milestones and make recovery observable and repeatable.

commits.subject: feat(m12): recover logical outputs through display topology changes
commits.outcome: Match OS device paths/EDID/connector/GPU signals with confidence, debounce events, rebuild affected sinks, retain absent targets and never silently bind an ambiguous output to an operator display.

commits.subject: feat(m12): add transactional project persistence and crash recovery
commits.outcome: Use SQLite snapshots/journal for authored state, separate transient telemetry, explicit checkpoint/dirty state and atomic save-as/portable export; preserve relative media paths and migrate with backups.

commits.subject: feat(m12): supervise engine workers and contain failures
commits.outcome: Detect heartbeat/deadline failure, recreate render/device resources with bounded attempts, keep UI/control responsive and apply configured fallback/blackout; maintain last applied runtime revision and resumable source state.

commits.subject: test(m12): qualify power loss hotplug faults and soak behavior
commits.outcome: Run interrupted writes, migration failures, killed UI/controller/source/render workers, GPU device loss, 100 topology cycles, decoder corruption and a 72-hour qualified workload with resource/queue budgets.

milestones.title: Windows beta release qualification
milestones.goal: Ship an installable Windows x64 build whose supported behavior and limitations are backed by reproducible evidence.

commits.subject: build(m13): package standalone Windows binaries and dependencies
commits.outcome: Produce versioned ZIP/installable package, default configuration, embedded UI, dependency notices, corresponding-source/build materials and checksums; avoid undocumented runtime prerequisites.

commits.subject: test(m13): verify clean installation offline operation and upgrade
commits.outcome: Test non-developer machine, Unicode/long paths, no network access after installation, firewall/pairing behavior, project upgrade/rollback and runtime absence diagnostics.

commits.subject: perf(m13): certify reference workloads and resource budgets
commits.outcome: Publish exact source revision, hardware/driver/OS/media hashes, frame timings, seek latencies, capacity limits, network tests and recovery/soak results; unresolved mandatory Windows requirements block full beta qualification.

commits.subject: docs(m13): close Windows beta gates and prepare release artifacts
commits.outcome: Complete requirement traceability, operator guide, known limitations and changelog; tag only the final green commit. Build candidate artifacts; publish or push only within the active task authorization.

milestones.title: Native Windows ARM64 port
milestones.goal: Run the same Windows application natively on ARM64 and qualify adapters independently from x64 emulation.

commits.subject: build(m14): add native ARM64 dependency and toolchain builds
commits.outcome: Use current native Windows ARM runner/toolset, audit SIMD, calling conventions and third-party libraries; do not load x64 DLLs into an ARM64 process.

commits.subject: feat(m14): qualify native rendering decode and sharing capabilities
commits.outcome: Run D3D rendering and decode corpus on real ARM hardware; build/port Spout and OMT dependencies where supported and expose missing capabilities without losing project state.

commits.subject: test(m14): verify ARM64 playback recovery and package parity
commits.outcome: Run editor/control/mapping tests and physical-output/fault suite natively, with architecture identity captured in evidence and x64-emulation results labeled separately.

commits.subject: docs(m14): publish the tested Windows ARM64 feature matrix
commits.outcome: Add ARM64 artifacts, performance profiles and tested differences; keep unsupported adapters explicit and retain unfulfilled product requirements in the backlog.

milestones.title: Linux x64 and PipeWire port
milestones.goal: Deliver native Linux output and frame sharing using the same project, command and composition contracts.

commits.subject: feat(m15): implement Linux presentation and decoder adapters
commits.outcome: Qualify Vulkan/GLES choices, Wayland/X11 installation behavior, GPU affinity and selected hardware-decoder paths; document kiosk/direct DRM/KMS as a distinct deployment mode where implemented.

commits.subject: feat(m15): integrate PipeWire receiving and publishing
commits.outcome: Expose direct app video streams, stable logical identities, format/modifier negotiation, synchronization and DMA-BUF import/export with bounded shared-memory fallback.

commits.subject: test(m15): qualify Linux topology and session recovery
commits.outcome: Test compositor/display changes, source reconnect, missing PipeWire/session services, multi-output placement and remote-only operation on fixed distro/driver profiles.

commits.subject: build(m15): package and qualify the Linux x64 release
commits.outcome: Run project round-trip and core parity suite, approved transport runtimes, clean installation and exact capability/feature matrix; publish source/build and dependency metadata.

milestones.title: macOS ARM64 and Syphon port
milestones.goal: Deliver a native Metal/Syphon implementation without changing the show model or remote contracts.

commits.subject: feat(m16): implement Metal presentation and VideoToolbox paths
commits.outcome: Integrate native resource import, color conversions, fullscreen outputs and timestamped decoding through the chosen renderer with explicit ownership and synchronization.

commits.subject: feat(m16): add bidirectional Syphon and managed-app lifecycle
commits.outcome: Expose named outputs through IOSurface/Metal-compatible paths, handle sender discovery/generation changes and implement macOS process/session behavior.

commits.subject: test(m16): qualify display reconnection media and UI independence
commits.outcome: Exercise physical display removal, app failure, multi-output frame sets, media corpus, project interchange, browser loss and native hardware identity.

commits.subject: build(m16): package and qualify the macOS ARM64 release
commits.outcome: Bundle required open dependencies and UI, define signing/notarization deployment procedure as available, run clean-machine tests and publish a capability/performance matrix.

milestones.title: Linux ARM64 and Raspberry Pi profile
milestones.goal: Run bounded installations and render-node workloads on qualified ARM64 boards with an honest hardware capability profile.

commits.subject: build(m17): add reproducible Linux ARM64 builds and board profiles
commits.outcome: Select named Pi/OS/driver/storage/thermal configurations; compile dependencies natively or cross-build with a pinned sysroot and keep ARM32 armhf as a separate optional target.

commits.subject: feat(m17): select board-appropriate decode shader and texture paths
commits.outcome: Query GPU compressed formats and decode capabilities, validate V4L2/platform paths where available, use precompiled effect variants and allow remote editor operation.

commits.subject: test(m17): qualify thermal storage network and output budgets
commits.outcome: Run sustained playback/seek/mapping/PipeWire/OMT cases on real boards, test throttling and reconnect, measure memory and preview encoding cost and avoid claiming desktop throughput.

commits.subject: docs(m17): publish ARM64 limits and decide the armhf extension
commits.outcome: Document qualified workloads, conversion presets and adapter availability. Add a separately scoped armhf milestone only if needed; official OMT AOT support cannot be assumed on ARM32.

milestones.title: Camera-assisted calibration extension
milestones.goal: Add automated calibration through the existing calibration-data interface without changing composition or cue semantics.

commits.subject: feat(m18): define capture sessions and calibration observations
commits.outcome: Version camera/projector intrinsics, patterns, observations and confidence; preserve manual calibration and reproducible captures.

commits.subject: feat(m18): implement a bounded structured-light solver
commits.outcome: Start with a documented supported geometry/camera setup, robust correspondence and reprojection error; solver outputs normal versioned patches.

commits.subject: feat(m18): expose calibration review and refinement tools
commits.outcome: Provide operator confidence/error visualization, rejected points and reversible manual refinement; require intentional application of captured results.

commits.subject: test(m18): qualify calibration accuracy against physical references
commits.outcome: Record repeatability, residuals, invalid captures, moved devices and physical seam/color tests before expanding supported setup classes.

milestones.title: Multiple GPUs and distributed render nodes
milestones.goal: Scale execution placement and coordinated presentation while preserving project identity and deterministic show actions.

commits.subject: feat(m19): partition render work by GPU and node ownership
commits.outcome: Place source instances, compositions and patches explicitly; account for texture/asset movement and avoid hidden cross-GPU readback.

commits.subject: feat(m19): replicate versioned assets and scheduled show state
commits.outcome: Use content-verified local assets, prepare barriers, future show-clock execution, deterministic seeds and generation/revision reconciliation.

commits.subject: feat(m19): add node health synchronization and controlled failover
commits.outcome: Separate clock synchronization from physical scanout/genlock, expose drift/readiness and define backup/failure ownership without promising seamless recovery from all hardware faults.

commits.subject: test(m19): qualify cluster timing capacity and failure behavior
commits.outcome: Run measured multi-node latency/drift tests, network partitions, late preparation, node loss and supported hardware synchronization; publish supported installation profiles.

acceptance_scenarios.title: One simple surface
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Import an image/video, drop it on the default composition, adjust a quad and play; no manual routing/container setup.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Arbitrary surface sets
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Operate one, three and many surfaces through the same unbounded collection model; no special two-output branches.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Continuous and independent content
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Span one canvas over connected surfaces, then change one destination while others keep their content and transport.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Curved geometry
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Render calibrated content on a curved/mesh surface with a stable UV chart and reversible point edits.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Many-to-many projector patches
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: One surface spans multiple projectors and one projector covers multiple surfaces without duplicating content ownership.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Library and nested reuse
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Organize, search, relink and inspect asset usages; inline/nested content remains reachable and reusable references remain explicit.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Instance ownership
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Independent placements have independent playheads; explicitly shared instances reuse one source and stop only when their lifecycle policy allows.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Transport directions
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Receive and publish supported local/network transports through equivalent frame/port contracts; absent adapters retain configuration.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Coherent frame sets
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: A cooperating multi-output producer publishes common frame identity and completion; grouped routing never mixes resource generations.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Native output independence
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Program output remains native and active without a browser; slow or absent output consumers cannot create unbounded queues.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Complete parameter exposure
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Registry inventory and OSCQuery tree agree on every application parameter and structural command, including access modes and unavailable states.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Reliable state changes
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Validate, deduplicate and atomically apply commands; distinguish accepted/applied revisions and resubscribe/resnapshot after reconnect.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Managed-app protocol
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Discover, launch/attach, control parameters and bind named outputs for one-output and multi-output reference clients.

acceptance_scenarios.title: App failure ownership
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Only owned processes follow shutdown/restart policy; simulate delayed readiness, process death, port stalls and restart generations.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Codec and format matrix
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Use a versioned corpus covering H.264/H.265, ProRes, HAP variants, DXV variants and other relevant media with explicit bit-depth/alpha/decode-path results.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Scrub accuracy
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Rapid obsolete seeks cancel; settled requests select the correct PTS/frame, including long-GOP, VFR, reverse, proxy and loop cases.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Color alpha and blending
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Golden/reference renders verify colorspace/range/transfer, premultiplied alpha, transition endpoints, masks, blend seams and correction within declared tolerances.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Show clock and audio
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Independent sources, audio and cue changes use one explicit rational/timestamp model; loop, pause, seek and clock changes have defined behavior.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Transition bank
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Every shipped shader has a manifest, defaults, attribution, endpoint behavior, deterministic grouping and validated GPU variants.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Local and remote editor
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Same UI can inspect/edit through documented command contracts, upload/relink content and recover after loss of connection.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Editor failure
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Close/reload/crash the browser during active playback; output and show clock continue with no dependency on editor frame callbacks.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Display reconnection
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Repeat unplug/replug and topology changes; retain calibration and desired modes, restore confident matches and leave ambiguous matches offline.

acceptance_scenarios.title: GPU and worker recovery
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Inject device loss and worker hangs/death; record bounded retry, fallback behavior, lost-output interval and surviving control responsiveness.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Save integrity
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Interrupt save/export, exhaust disk space, lose referenced media and reopen; preserve the last valid authored project and report unsaved changes.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Project migrations
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Upgrade old fixtures, reject unsupported future formats without damage, back up before migration and verify no silent parameter/ID loss.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Performance budgets
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Measure fixed qualified workloads with machine/media hashes, warm/cold separation, latency percentiles, missed deadlines, RAM/VRAM and transition peaks.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Long-run operation
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Complete 72-hour qualified playback with scheduled faults and bounded memory/queue/resource use; classify all repeats/drops and recovery events.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Capabilities and portability
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Missing GPU features, runtimes and adapters are discoverable in UI/API and do not delete saved objects or silently change output.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Native ARM identity
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Compile and run native ARM builds and dependency probes; record architecture, SIMD choices and any separately labeled emulation results.

acceptance_scenarios.title: GPL and dependency provenance
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Public-source reproducibility, SPDX inventory, corresponding build/source materials and approved optional-runtime distribution; NDI approval remains a real gate.

acceptance_scenarios.title: CI and evidence integrity
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Required checks fail closed, never pass on zero tests, and associate reports with exact source revisions; software rendering is not labeled hardware qualification.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Portable core builds
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Windows/Linux/macOS build and test domain/control/persistence contracts without platform GPU/UI headers; native platform ports have separate gates.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Cue ownership and routing
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Replace/Keep/Clear semantics, group readiness and transition interruption preserve unaffected destinations; dual-state app transitions have an explicit resource strategy.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Development feedback
acceptance_scenarios.criterion: Vite interface updates and asynchronous shader development can refresh previews while engine output continues; production builds contain no development server.

requirements.title: Elegant reactive editor and media explorer
Arbitrary connected surfaces and multi-output sources
Spout Syphon PipeWire NDI and OMT output
Required desktop architectures and optional ARM boards
